content.summary: Structured 60-minute multi-grade plan for Grades 1, 2, 3 on "Plants, Roots, and Soil Conservation" using zero-cost rural TLM.
content.common_theme: Foundational concepts of Plants, Roots, and Soil Conservation explored through observation, slate work, and peer collaboration.

grade_plans.learning_objective: Grade 1 students understand key age-appropriate foundations of Plants, Roots, and Soil Conservation through concrete manipulatives.

grade_plans.peer_learning_activity: Partner review using Student Slates & Chalk to test comprehension.
